raw_response:
My plot is very small, only a small piece for groundnuts, and I am intercropping with cassava like my neighbors here in Lindi. I do not have cash to buy fertilizer for nuts — nobody around here puts fertilizer on groundnuts anyway, the nuts make their own goodness in the soil. I have some old manure from the goats near the house, I will scatter a little. I keep my own seed from last harvest because the agro-dealer is far and improved nut seed is too costly for such a small plot.
